spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
What pleases, brightens, strengthens, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 Hunger, appetite.
2 The plantain.
3 A sort of onion.
4 A stomachic, a carminative, any medicine, fruit or fossil, supposed to strengthen the tone of the stomach and restore lost appetite.
E.
रुच to shine, &c., and ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं)
1 Splendid, beautiful.
2 Irradiating, illumining, beautifying.
3 Gratifying, pleasing.
4 Whetting, sharpening, (the appetite.)
m. (-नः)
1 A species of the silk-cotton tree.
2 The onion.
3 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaca.)
4 The Cassia fistula.
5 The pomegranate.
6 The citron.
7 A stomachic, a carminative.
f. (-नी)
1 A yellow pigment, commonly Gorocanā, and supposed to be the concrete bile of the cow, or according to some authorities, to be found in the head of the animal, used as a medicine, a dye, and perfume.
2 The manna of bambus.
3 A excellent woman.
4 A red lotus.
f. (-ना-नी)
1 A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, a sort of Crinum?
f. (-नी)
1 A variety of Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
2 Red arsenic.
E.
रुच to shine, ल्युट् or युच् aff.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī.
E.
कन् added to रोचनी the same.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Splendid, shining.
2 Pleasing, gratifying.
m. (-नः)
A tuft or curl of hair round the neck of a horse or on the lower part of it.
E.
रुच to shine, aff. शानच्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Elegantly dressed or ornamented.
2 Splendid, brilliant.
E.
रुच to shine, इष्णुच् aff.

n. (-चिः)
Light.
E.
रुच to shine, इसुन् aff.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
To be illuminated or enlightened.
E.
रुच to shine, aff. ण्य.
